sentences.text: The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (for short 'BNSS') to quash the proceedings against the petitioner/accused No.3 in Crime No.220 of 2024 on the file of Alair Police Station, Rachakonda, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 318(4), 274, 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNS'), Section 57 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'FSSA') and 20(1) of the Cigarettes and Others Tobacco Products Act, 2003 (for short 'COPT Act').
2.

entities.text: Cigarettes and Others Tobacco Products Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Heard Sri Y.Bala Murali, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Sri Arun Kumar Doddla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1-State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the matter is squarely covered by the order dated 05.07.2021 in Criminal Petition No.152 of 2020 and batch.
4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor also submitted that the issue in the present criminal petition is covered by the earlier order in the above criminal petition.

5. In view of the said representation and as the matter is squarely covered by the order in the above criminal petition, this criminal petition is allowed in terms of the above said order, adopting the reasoning contained therein.
The proceedings against the petitioner/accused in Crime No.220 of 2024 on the file of Alair Police Station, Rachakonda, are hereby quashed.
Further, the Station House Officer/Investigating Officer is hereby directed to return the seized property on proper identification and verification under due acknowledgment.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, in this Criminal Petition shall also stand closed.
gv Note: Registry is directed to annex the copy of the order dated 05.07.2021 in Criminal and batch.
